FN-YMPIE66-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 269
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/07/2025
Senate Bill 269 as introduced would codify current practices of the Alabama Emergency
Management Agency to use its appropriated funds to purchase items that support the functions
of the department, including public educational materials on emergency preparedness.
